name: Marib Dam
scope: Complete ancient MaribDam remains in the1843Arnaudsurvey phase: both northern and southern sluice assemblies and their stone retaining moles, three north/two south rounded gate abutments, exposed sluice channels, remnant masonry/earthfill bank arms with the great central breach left open, intrinsic northern curved revetment and separate ancient distribution basin. Primary pace/unit dimensions and drawing topology are approximate; hidden heights/sections and individual ruin profiles estimated. Exclude modern1986dam/upstreamreservoir, natural Balaqmountains/wadi/rockcliffs, distant city/temples/inscriptions as lettering and archaeological elements outside this dam system. This is a ruined historical structure, not a hypothetical restored intact ancient dam.
